title: MemorySpacesCreateRequest
description: Create a space (a Mind) with a caller-named space_id. Any authenticated principal the provider's admission maps may call it when the space does not exist (MEM-R003); on an existing space it requires `admin` (A3-D1) and answers a no-op success with created: false, without writing and without exposing whether the id belongs to another principal. No grant row, subject or other space metadata is carried beyond the optional display_name, which is set on creation only (the memory.subjects.ensure kind precedent, §7.5). Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt (§7.0.2).

space_id.description: Caller-named space identifier; it is also the first component of the idempotency dedup namespace (§7.0.5).
space_id.title: SpaceId

display_name.description: Optional human label; absence = unnamed. Set only on creation — a repeat create never changes it.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
idempotency_key.title: IdempotencyKey
